name: God (Author)
description: Nagatsuki Tappei is the author and creator of Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu, affectionately referred to by the fandom and in Q&A sessions as 'God' or 'The Author'. Writing under the pen name 'Mouse-Colored Cat' (Nezumiiro Nyanko), he began publishing the web novel in 2012 before its light novel serialization.
